description: This file defines an enum class VoiceWakeMode with associated string values and a companion object with a method to parse from raw string values.

classes.name: VoiceWakeMode
classes.description: An enum class representing different modes of voice wake functionality (Off, Foreground, Always) with a method to parse raw string values into enum entries.

methods.name: fromRawValue
methods.description: Converts a raw string to the corresponding VoiceWakeMode enum value, defaulting to Foreground if no match is found.
